description: Full detail for one publication by its id (the slug from search_placements), including price, price with the 3.5% checkout processing fee, authority scores, turnaround, disclosure policy, link type (linkAttributes: "dofollow" where the store sells it as dofollow, otherwise "unspecified"; dofollowVariantId points to a separate dofollow package for the same outlet), whether it can be ordered now (available), the outlet's logo, and an example article where one is published.
name: get_placement
title: Get placement detail
